definitions.explanation: A cemetery or burial ground, often a large, well-maintained park-like facility. Used for both public and private cemeteries.

examples.japanese: {霊園|れいえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{墓参|はかまい}り→お墓参り：15303_ohakamairi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go visit a grave at the cemetery.

examples.japanese: {市営|しえい}{霊園|れいえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区画|くかく}→区画：11930_kukaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}んだ→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧。
examples.english: I applied for a plot at the municipal cemetery.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{霊園|れいえん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This cemetery has lots of greenery and is in a quiet setting.

notes: Often used in the formal names of cemeteries: {多磨|たま}{霊園|れいえん} (Tama Cemetery), {青山|あおやま}{霊園|れいえん} (Aoyama Cemetery). Common collocations: ⟦{公営|こうえい}→公営：22485_kouei⟧{霊園|れいえん} (public cemetery), {民営|みんえい}{霊園|れいえん} (private cemetery), {霊園|れいえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (cemetery maintenance). Compare with ⟦{墓地|ぼち}→墓地：15232_bochi⟧ (graveyard — more general), {墓園|ぼえん} (cemetery — less common). {霊園|れいえん} tends to suggest a larger, more modern, park-style facility.
